title: Registry of Pancreatic Fluid Collections and Pancreatic Cysts
brief_summary: This registry aims to assess the outcomes of patients undergoing EUS-guided interventions of pancreatic fluid collections and EUS examination of pancreatic cyst lesions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1\. All patients aged 18 years or over, who are undergoing EUS evaluation of a pancreatic cyst lesion or endoscopy-based (EUS-guided) interventions for pancreatic fluid collection at the Center for Interventional Endoscopy will be included in this registry.

Exclusion Criteria

1. Age less than 18 years
2. No pancreatic cyst on EUS examination or no pancreatic fluid collection amenable to endoscopic drainage on EUS examination
study_population: All patients aged 18 years or over undergoing EUS evaluation of pancreatic cyst lesions or endoscopy-based (EUS-guided) interventions of pancreatic fluid collections.
